Attacker-controlled source: userspace-supplied netlink message attribute set (presence/absence and payloads fully attacker-chosen). Missing guarantee: per-attribute non-NULL (required) validation before use. Unsafe use: dereference or nested-parse of an attributes[]/tb[] slot without a covering check. Consequence: NULL-deref oops from unprivileged input, or OOB access when the unchecked value drives sizes/indices.
